options.description: Support access tenants without subscriptions. It's uncommon but useful to run tenant level commands, such as 'az ad'
options.name: --allow-no-subscriptions

options.description: Federated token that can be used for OIDC token exchange
options.name: --federated-token

options.description: Log in using the Virtual Machine's identity
name: --identity
-i

options.description: Credentials like user password, or for a service principal, provide client secret or a pem file with key and public certificate. Will prompt if not given
name: --password
-p

options.description: Used in the /authorize request. It can cover only one static resource
options.name: --scope

options.description: The credential representing a service principal
options.name: --service-principal

options.description: The AAD tenant, must provide when using service principals
name: --tenant
-t

options.description: Used with a service principal configured with Subject Name and Issuer Authentication in order to support automatic certificate rolls
options.name: --use-cert-sn-issuer

options.description: Use CLI's old authentication flow based on device code. CLI will also use this if it can't launch a browser in your behalf, e.g. in remote SSH or Cloud Shell
options.name: --use-device-code

options.description: User name, service principal, or managed service identity ID
name: --username
-u
